scripts.build: npm --prefix services/erasegraph-mcp run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/erasegraph-mcp run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/erasegraph-mcp test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix services/erasegraph-mcp audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix apps/web audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
